description: Phase 6 Community Features - User profiles, griefer profiles, notifications, analytics, and Discord webhooks

userStories.title: Connect player profile page to real API
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see real profile data when visiting a player page so that profiles show actual information instead of mock data.
acceptanceCriteria: Player page at /player/[username] fetches data from GET /api/users/[username]
Displays real username, role badge, and join date from API
Shows real stats (reports submitted, verified count, comments count, reputation score)
Shows loading state while fetching
Shows error/not-found state for invalid usernames
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Mock page exists at src/app/player/[username]/page.tsx with hardcoded data for 'trustme'. API at /api/users/[username] and service functions getUserByUsername/getUserStats/getUserProfile already exist in airtable.ts.

userStories.title: Display profile details and social links
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see bio, location, and social links on player profiles so I can learn more about community members.
acceptanceCriteria: Profile page shows bio text if set
Shows location if set
Shows social links section with website, Discord username, and Steam profile
Social links open in new tab
Empty fields are hidden, not shown as blank
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: UserProfile type in src/types/user.ts already has bio, avatar, location, website, discord, steam fields. getUserProfile in airtable.ts fetches these.

userStories.title: Add edit profile form
userStories.description: As a user, I want to edit my own profile (bio, location, social links) so I can customize how I appear to the community.
acceptanceCriteria: Edit button visible only when viewing own profile
Edit form with fields: bio (max 500 chars), location, website URL, Discord username, Steam profile URL
Form validates inputs with Zod (URL format for website/steam, character limits)
Submits to PUT /api/users/me/profile
Shows success/error feedback after save
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: PUT /api/users/me/profile endpoint and updateUserProfile service function already exist. UserProfileUpdate type defined in src/types/user.ts. Follow existing form patterns (React Hook Form + Zod) from submit report page.

userStories.title: Add avatar upload to profile
userStories.description: As a user, I want to upload a profile avatar so my profile has a personal image.
acceptanceCriteria: Avatar upload button on edit profile form
Accepts image files (jpg, png, webp) up to 2MB
Uploads to Cloudinary via existing cloudinary service
Avatar URL saved to user profile in Airtable
Avatar displayed on profile page with fallback to default icon
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Cloudinary service exists at src/lib/services/cloudinary.ts. Follow evidence upload pattern from report submission for the upload flow.

userStories.title: Display recent activity on player profile
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a player's recent reports and comments on their profile so I can see their community contributions.
acceptanceCriteria: Profile page shows 'Recent Reports' section with last 5 reports by this user
Each report shows title, game, severity badge, status badge, and date
Reports link to full report page
Profile page shows 'Recent Comments' section with last 5 comments
Each comment shows snippet, linked report title, and date
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: May need new service functions to fetch reports by reporter_id and comments by author_id with limit parameter. Existing getReports has filtering support.

userStories.title: Add griefer aggregation service functions
userStories.description: As a developer, I need service functions to aggregate all reports about a specific griefer so the griefer profile page can display meaningful data.
acceptanceCriteria: Add getReportsByGrieferName(name) function to airtable.ts that fetches all reports matching a griefer name (case-insensitive)
Add getGrieferStats(name) function that returns: total reports, severity breakdown, game breakdown, status breakdown, first/last reported dates
Add getGrieferRiskScore(stats) function that calculates risk level (Low/Medium/High/Critical) based on report count and severity distribution
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Follow existing service function patterns in src/lib/services/airtable.ts. Airtable filterByFormula supports LOWER() for case-insensitive matching.

userStories.title: Create griefer profile API route
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an API endpoint to fetch griefer profile data so the frontend can display griefer profiles.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/griefers/[name] returns aggregated griefer data
Response includes: griefer name, risk score, stats, and paginated report list
Returns 404 if no reports found for that griefer name
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Create at src/app/api/griefers/[name]/route.ts. Follow existing API route patterns (NextResponse.json, error handling).

userStories.title: Create griefer profile page
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view a griefer's profile page showing all reports and risk assessment so I can quickly evaluate a reported player.
acceptanceCriteria: Page at /griefer/[name] fetches data from GET /api/griefers/[name]
Shows griefer name and risk level badge (color-coded)
Displays stats: total reports, severity breakdown, games reported in
Lists all reports about this griefer with status/severity badges
Loading and not-found states handled
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Follow dark theme styling from existing pages. Use existing StatusBadge and SeverityBadge components for report list items.

userStories.title: Link report cards to griefer profiles
userStories.description: As a user, I want to click a griefer's name on any report card to navigate to their griefer profile.
acceptanceCriteria: Griefer name on ReportCard component is a clickable link
Link navigates to /griefer/[grieferName]
Griefer name link styled distinctly (underline or color) to indicate clickability
Links work on Intel Board, Dashboard, and Report Detail pages
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: ReportCard component at src/components/reports/ReportCard.tsx. Use Next.js Link component.

userStories.title: Add notification types and service layer
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a notification data model and service functions so the system can create and manage user notifications.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Notification type to src/types/ with fields: id, userId, type (report_status_change | comment_reply | report_verified | report_rejected), title, message, relatedReportId, isRead, createdAt
Add NOTIFICATIONS table name to airtable-client.ts
Add createNotification(), getUserNotifications(userId, limit), markNotificationRead(id), markAllNotificationsRead(userId), getUnreadCount(userId) to airtable.ts
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Requires Notifications table in Airtable with matching fields. Follow existing service function patterns. Table may not exist yet in Airtable - add a note in progress.txt if so.

userStories.title: Add notification API routes
userStories.description: As a developer, I need API endpoints for notifications so the frontend can fetch and manage them.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/notifications returns current user's notifications (paginated, newest first)
GET /api/notifications/unread-count returns unread count
PUT /api/notifications/[id]/read marks a single notification as read
PUT /api/notifications/read-all marks all notifications as read
All endpoints require authentication
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Create routes under src/app/api/notifications/. Use getServerSession for auth check, following existing protected route patterns.

userStories.title: Add notification bell to site header
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a notification bell icon with unread count in the header so I know when I have new notifications.
acceptanceCriteria: Bell icon visible in header/navbar for logged-in users
Shows unread count badge (red dot with number) when count > 0
Clicking bell opens dropdown with last 5 notifications
Each notification shows title, message snippet, and relative time
Unread notifications visually distinct from read ones
'View all' link at bottom navigates to full notifications page
Clicking a notification marks it as read and navigates to related report
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Add to existing Navbar/Header component. Use SWR for polling unread count. Follow existing component patterns.

userStories.title: Trigger notifications on report status changes
userStories.description: As a user, I want to receive notifications when my report's status changes so I stay informed about moderation decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: When admin/mod changes report status, a notification is created for the report author
Notification includes old status, new status, and report title
Notification type is 'report_status_change' for general changes, 'report_verified' when verified, 'report_rejected' when rejected
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Hook into existing report status update logic in admin dashboard or report API routes. Create notification using createNotification service function.

userStories.title: Add analytics aggregation service
userStories.description: As a developer, I need analytics aggregation functions so the analytics dashboard can display platform-wide statistics.
acceptanceCriteria: Add getAnalyticsOverview() function returning: total reports, reports by status, reports by severity, reports by game, total users, total comments
Add getTopReporters(limit) function returning top users by verified report count
Add getRecentActivity(limit) function returning most recent reports and comments
All functions use existing Airtable service patterns
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Add to src/lib/services/airtable.ts. Some stats (like reports by game) require fetching all reports and aggregating in JS since Airtable doesn't support GROUP BY.

userStories.title: Create admin analytics dashboard page
userStories.description: As an admin, I want an analytics dashboard showing platform statistics so I can understand community health and trends.
acceptanceCriteria: Page at /admin/analytics accessible only to admin users
Shows overview cards: total reports, total users, total comments, verification rate
Shows reports by game breakdown (bar or list)
Shows reports by severity breakdown (color-coded)
Shows reports by status breakdown
Shows top 10 reporters leaderboard
Shows recent activity feed
Loading state while data fetches
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Create at src/app/admin/analytics/page.tsx. Follow admin page pattern from src/app/admin/page.tsx for auth checks. Use Tailwind for simple chart-like visuals (progress bars, stat cards) rather than adding a chart library.

userStories.title: Add Discord webhook notification endpoint
userStories.description: As an admin, I want verified reports to send a Discord webhook notification so our Discord community stays informed about new verified griefers.
acceptanceCriteria: Add DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL to env config and .env.example
Add sendDiscordWebhook(report) utility function that sends a Discord embed with report details
Webhook fires when a report status changes to 'Verified'
Discord embed includes: griefer name, game, severity, reporter, and link to report
Gracefully handles missing webhook URL (skips without error)
Gracefully handles webhook delivery failures (logs error, does not block status change)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Discord webhooks are simple POST requests with JSON body - no Discord.js library needed. Add to the same status change flow as notification creation (US-013).
